content_fields.title: Verify that daemon configuration files are secured (Docker)
content_fields.description: Verify that the Docker daemon configuration files are correctly secured.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means checking ownership and mode on the daemon configuration, socket, service unit and certificate files against the expected baseline.
content_fields.found: The files in question are not part of the repository.
content_fields.missing: Host filesystem access to inspect the daemon files.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification is performed on the host, not against repository content.
content_fields.action: The platform team should perform the file permission audit on each container host.
